# Mabel Colby

## Overview

- **Age:** Teenager (classmate of Nell)  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Regent's Academy  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** the "rose-red" girl  <sub>[v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel is a striking and attractive girl with dark, expressive eyes and a vibrant, rosy-red complexion. She won the beauty prize among the Second Year classes at Regent's Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Mabel is a lively, imaginative, and reflective girl who possesses a heart brimming with yearning dreams. Though she appears vibrant and striking, she enjoys deep, shared confidences and is thoughtful about life and friendship.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- Imaginative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- Lively  <sub>[v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012)</sub>
- Thoughtful  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Abilities

- Academic studies at Regent's Academy  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## History

Mabel enrolled at Regent's Academy in Port Marlow, where she joined the Second Year class. During her time at the Academy, she became part of Nell Harcourt's close circle of thoughtful and imaginative friends, along with Honora Hollis. She was voted the most beautiful student in the Second Year class. Though Nell left Regent's after a year to attend college, Mabel remained a cherished friend with whom Nell maintained correspondence.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c36 P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021), [v1 c36 P36](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0036)_
